therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Somatostatin receptor targeting for tumor imaging
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor detection and staging via somatostatin receptor expression
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Detection and Staging of Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma Using Standard Uptake Value for NETSPOT Imaging

results.effect_size: NETSPOT SUV median volumes: OP-Primary 7.21 cm3, OP-Nodes 4.84 cm3, OC-Primary 2.87 cm3, OC-Nodes 2.46 cm3, Larynx-Nodes 3.24 cm3
results.target_engagement_evidence: SUV measurements demonstrated uptake in tumor sites with threshold >1.5 for 68Ga-DOTATATE
biomarker_changes: Standard Uptake Value measurements for tumor detection
subgroup_findings: OP-Primary Tumor showed highest SUV volume (7.21 cm3)
Secondary endpoint showed higher SUV volumes: OP-Primary 14.98 cm3, OC-Primary 13.11 cm3
